若 packet.continuation.scope=calendar，只处理日历：decisions=[]，保留当前 archiveTitle，不修改新闻、tracking、期号或窗口。按 pinned pages 的完整身份提交 calendarReview 和已核实 upcoming/removeUpcomingIds；部分核验仍显式 deferred，GitHub 保留队列重试。使用同一期单 inbox，不与新闻组成 bundle。
若 editorialInput.calendarWork 存在，upcomingDiscovery 只是预览；必须按 calendarWork.pages 中的 blobSha 读取完整分页（automation/state 分支 automation/batches/<edition-id>/<name>）。calendarReview.pages 对每个 blobSha、calendarReview.platforms 对 PC/PlayStation/Xbox/Nintendo 各给一个 key/status/reason；status 只能 reviewed 或 deferred，reason 记录实际核验或具体阻塞。未读完不能声称 reviewed；延期必须显式保留。分页只提供日历线索，采用前仍须打开官方详情核验。
发布会条目须用coveredFactIds登记正文或简讯实际覆盖的showcaseFacts；同一页面、同一游戏不等于全部事实已覆盖。只有存在会改变正文事实边界的实质证据缺口才继续needs_review，不因热度或预算排除，也不要把needs_review当作默认保守选项。
输出 contractVersion=2。你是游戏行业简报编辑；事件事实仅来自已打开的 packet 证据。对 packages 和 trackingQueue 每个 eventKey 恰好给一个 include/exclude/needs_review。needs_review 必须 tracking=true；跟踪项无新证据也须明确继续或关闭，关闭时 tracking=false 且 reason 写依据。
从 automation/status/<edition-id>.json 原样复制 packet.blobSha 到 packetBlobSha；不得使用可变分支 HEAD。publishability=requires_subject_identity 只能 exclude/needs_review，不得从标题虚构 titleKey/titleEn。
若 packet.continuation.scope=news，这是受信的同一期有界续接包：只处理本包 packages/trackingQueue，保留已发布正文、标题、头条和 issue/window，不提交 upcoming 变更，不添加 showcaseRefs、其他批次或窗口外事实。若 scope=showcase，严格按 scoped announcement/fact 身份补齐，不把普通新闻混入，也不因部分材料或 Highlights 声称完整。
lane=interviews、features、industry、reviews、awards 可按文章/采访/评测/分析/奖项信息本身首次发布的时间准入，但必须有明确的信息增量（首次披露、独立采访、调查、技术/产业分析、正式评分或奖项变化）。普通观点、推荐、促销软文、无新增信息的旧闻复述仍应 exclude。不得把窗口外旧事件伪装成窗口内 breaking news；标题摘要须体现本次新增内容。
证据门槛按最终 factStatus 判断，不按来源数量机械升级：official 要求已打开一手来源；单一已打开、注册为 media 的可信媒体，只要主体、窗口和核心事实清楚，就可以 media_report 发布，不得仅因“只有一家媒体”或 readiness=single-media 而 needs_review；可信媒体明确转述可识别的官方公告、采访或发言时，可以 media_relay_official，verification 写清转述链。multi_source_verified 才要求两家独立可靠来源。readiness 只描述证据组成，不是发布资格。未确认但具有新闻价值且来源边界清楚的内容可进 rumors，factStatus=unconfirmed、tracking=true，并在标题摘要保留不确定性；只有主体身份未解、来源互相冲突、固定窗口无法确认、动态聚合数据缺少所需快照等实质阻塞才使用 needs_review。A级也不豁免时间/来源要求。中英文新闻标题和archiveTitle须自带明确的游戏、公司或人物主语，离开上方主体栏仍能独立理解。中文直述具体事实，verification 说明证据边界，不用宣传套话。
每个 include 决定必须填写完整 sharedFactFrame，作为两种语言共用的事实边界；subjectTitleKey/platforms 必须与最终 Canonical 决定一致，日期、时刻、数字、人物机构、版本专名只能来自所选证据，不得新增。
中文游戏名依次查 config/title-translations.json、editorialInput.titleHints，仍缺才做 title-only open-web lookup。优先官方简中，其次已查证广泛使用的 common_translation；否则保留原名，titleZhCn=null、titleZhStatus=unavailable。禁止机翻/自造名称。有官方大陆简中渠道的游戏，版本、角色、职业、模式、机制等采用大陆官方术语。所有名称/术语查询仅规范名称，不得增加事件事实、时间、平台、发行信息、来源分类、tracking 或候选。
默认尝试完整 locales.en：在相同 include/sharedFactFrame 内独立写自然英文，优先英文一手证据正式专名；只有中文证据也不得扩充事实。entries 按 include 顺序以 eventKey 对应，upcoming 仅按 upcomingId 对应本次 patch，继承项不重复。headline/summary/verification/timeNote 必须完整英文，无中文 fallback；sourceReport 完整英文或 null，其余显示字段按需提供英文。
如果无法在事实边界内可靠完成完整英文稿，可以省略 locales.en；publisher 标记 unavailable，不能削弱中文 Canonical 来迁就英文。不要填写 factsDigest/canonicalCopyDigest/localeDigest 或猜最终 entryId，均由 trusted publisher 生成绑定。
archiveTitle 对应 period：日报｜、早报｜、晚报｜；英文对应 Daily Brief |、Morning Brief |、Evening Brief |。Daily 窗口为前日10:10 exclusive 至当日10:10 inclusive，plannedAt=当日12:00；10:10—12:00 新事实属于下一期，历史迁移窗口以 packet 为准。
早报 upcomingMode=replace 重建未来15天；晚报 inherit_and_patch。日报必须使用 upcomingMode=inherit_and_patch，不复制 upcomingBaseline.items；不要因为本次 packet 没有新的发售证据而提交空表覆盖历史。trusted publisher 继承 Canonical 基线并剔除当日及15天窗口外项。仅提交新增/变更 upcoming 或有证据支持延期取消的 removeUpcomingIds，必须有 HTTPS 来源。
upcomingBaseline.refreshRange 是 packet-only 的唯一日历例外：每天核验完整 startInclusive—endInclusive，不把旧期次当作已完成核验。打开开发商/发行商公告或 PlayStation/Nintendo/Xbox/Steam 官方页面；新查事实仅用于日历，不得改变新闻 packages/trackingQueue 决定、正文、时间、factStatus、来源分类或 tracking。无可靠来源不填充，不因发现失败删除条目。
upcomingDiscovery 仅是线索。优先复核日期冲突及不确定冲突，再把基线相关项、knownTitle/crossSource 作为排序提示；inBaseline 只表示基线中已存在，不等同于已计算出的基线变更。采用任何条目前，必须打开开发商/发行商公告或 PlayStation、Nintendo、Xbox、Steam 官方详情页，核实完整游戏身份、日期、平台、地区及正式版/抢先体验/移植/DLC 类型；reviewLinks 是待阅读文章，不是游戏项。候选与 observation 均为可读字段名对象；调用 decodeCalendarPacket 展开 observationDefaultsBySource 与 sharedObservationUrls。normalizedTitle 是派生分组键，不传入；null、dates/platforms 数组、announcementUrl、identity.key、identity 冲突和全部其他 observation 字段都应保留。日期冲突不可猜选。对 PC/PlayStation/Xbox/Nintendo 分别检查完整15天；coverage 为 failed/empty_or_changed、列表不全或任一遗漏计数大于0时针对补查，并在 sourceReport 记录实际检查和缺口，不得声称全量覆盖。

Dead by Daylight: Terrifier’s New Killer is No Laughing Matter
Hope you’re not afraid of clowns. Putting the laughter in slaughter, The Terrifier steps into Dead by Daylight as the hit horror multiplayer’s latest Killer.
A serial murderer fueled by a sick sense of humor, Art the Clown met his end at the hands of Sienna Shaw. Rising from the dead with a thirst for vengeance, Art’s dogged pursuit of his favorite final girl has led the two straight into the claws of The Entity and Dead by Daylight’s endless cycle of Trials.
Known for his unpredictable nature and ecstatic violence, The Terrifier makes a clear fit for Dead by Daylight ‘s fiendish roster. But with that chaos comes the challenge of making humor and horror blend together into a compelling gameplay loop for Killers and Survivors alike.
Players beware – it’s all fun and games until the clown pulls out a gun.
Joining the likes of Jason Voorhees and Freddy Krueger, Art the Clown is the latest addition to Dead by Daylight ‘s unmatched repertoire of horror legends. While past slashers were the killers that many grew up fearing, Art the Clown represents a more modern (and extreme) horror icon for a new generation of fans.
“I think the thing that attracts people to Art is how fun he is,” reflects Dave Richard, Dead by Daylight ‘s Creative Director. “He’s an absolute menace taking his time to torture and tease his victims before going all in for a big kill. We really wanted to lean into that fantasy when designing his kit.”
With his Power, Bag of Toys, Art reaches into his trash bag for a random selection of weapons including a flail, a flamethrower, a firearm, a beer bottle full of acid, and even his signature bike horn. Each successful hit with a toy builds its deadliness, eventually letting Art down injured Survivors and execute them with murderous glee.
Behaviour Interactive breaks down how they brought Art the Clown's terrifying antics to life.

packages.headline: Nioh 3 Is Coming to XBOX in 2027

sources.label: Xbox Wire
sources.evidenceText:
Return of the Ninja! Team NINJA and Koei Tecmo are bringing the Nioh series to XBOX for the first time with Nioh 3: Complete Edition. Explore the Age of the Samurai in Feudal Japan in the epic Dark Samurai Action RPG!
Nioh 3 Is Coming to XBOX in 2027
2025 marked the “Year of the Ninja” when the legendary Team NINJA development team released both Ninja Gaiden 2 Black and Ninja Gaiden 4 . Well, 2027 is poised to be the “Return of the Ninja” as for the first time ever, the Nioh series is making its debut on XBOX with Nioh 3 and Nioh 3: Complete Edition coming to XBOX Series X|S . The Complete Edition includes the full game and the two DLC expansions, which brings new story content, new bosses, new weapons, new abilities, endgame content, and more. For XBOX players, this is the perfect entry point into the series as it features the pinnacle of combat refinement you’ve come to know and expect from Team NINJA, as well as an open-field format that lets you explore and take on challenges at your own pace. No prior series knowledge is needed to understand the epic story that takes place across multiple eras of feudal Japan!
If you aren’t familiar with Nioh 3 , it’s Team NINJA’s take on the Age of the Samurai in Japan, as an open-field Dark Samurai Action RPG where you’re caught in a nefarious coup started right before you are appointed Shogun – the ruler of Japan. You play the role of Tokugawa Takechiyo, and just before taking the throne, your younger brother succumbs to his hatred and jealousy, and leads an army of Yokai (demonic spirits) to overthrow the natural order and take over Japan. Takechiyo survives thanks to the intervention of the Guardian Spirit Kusanagi, who lets you travel through time and experience battlefields across different eras and key locations.
Takechiyo, as one would expect of a Shogun-to-be, can wield a series-high amount of weapons – from a variety of swords, bows, gunpowder weapons, axes, spears, fist weapons, and more. Weapons and armor provide increases for a wide variety of combat stats – with plenty of drops to sort through, finding the right weapon with the perfect stats to complement your play style is a key element of the Nioh series. Players also have access to Transformed Arts, Ninjutsu, Onmyo Magic and creatures summoned through Summoning Seals for you to perfect the ultimate combat style.
Team NINJA is in peak form with the combat of Nioh 3 , and XBOX players getting to experience it for the first time is a key reason why 2027 marks the Return of the Ninja. After years of the development team experimenting and tweaking the series formula for Nioh 3, and following the incredible Xbox fan reactions to Ninja Gaiden 4 on XBOX, the team felt it was the perfect moment to release the series on XBOX – just in time for the series’ 10 th anniversary. The Nioh 3: Complete Edition gives XBOX players access to the base game, but also the two DLC expansions, Hell Rising and Bloody Insurrection . Both DLC expansions add to the game’s story with new Eras and locations to explore, adding new equipment, combat abilities, skills, and much more. The DLC also adds several end-game level modes, such as the Battlefield of Carnage, which challenges you to take on 100 floors of battlefields overrun with enemies and bosses.
Nioh 3 and Nioh 3: Complete Edition will launch for the first time on XBOX Series X|S beginning January 28, 2027 – don’t miss out on the epic battle!

AMDグラボで報告された「SSD無限酷使」不具合、今度はNVIDIAグラボでも発生か。1日で約1テラバイト書き込まれた事例も、寿命が怖い
NVIDIAは現地時間11月24日、GPU向けドライバー「 GeForce Game Ready Driver 」向けにバージョン621.40を配信した。同パッチではPCを操作していない間にもSSDへの大量の書き込みがおこなわれる不具合の修正をおこなっている。先日配信されたバージョン621.35でも同不具合が解消したとしていたが、一部ユーザーからは、621.35を適用しても依然として不具合が継続しているという報告も寄せられていた。
問題となっていたのは、「GeForce Game Ready Driver」のバージョン621.14および621.24で発生していた不具合だ。同バージョンでは、PCを操作していない状態でも「NVDisplay.Container.exe」というプロセスがログファイルへの書き込みを繰り返し、SSDに対して1日あたり数十GBから数百GBものデータが書き込まれているとみられていた。
この問題を受け、NVIDIAは11月21日に修正用のホットフィックスドライバーとしてバージョン621.35を配信した（ 関連記事 ）。しかしこのパッチを適用した一部ユーザーからは、適用後もSSDへの大量書き込みが続いているとの声も寄せられていた（ 関連記事 ）。起動時間から一定時間内は問題が解決したかのように見えるが、長時間の稼働によって、また不具合が発生していたとのこと。

Future Friends Gamesは11月23日、Freshly Baked Gamesが手がける一人称視点RPG『Queen's Domain』の販売本数が30万本を突破したことを発表した。
パブリッシャーのFuture Friends Gamesは11月23日、Freshly Baked Gamesが手がける一人称視点RPG『Queen’s Domain』の販売本数が30万本を突破したことを発表した。本作の対応プラットフォームはPC（Steam）/PS5/XBOX Series X|S/Nintendo Switch 2で、ゲーム内は日本語表示に対応。Steamでは「圧倒的に好評」ステータスを獲得するなど高い評価を受けているなか、売上についても好調が伝えられた。
『Queen’s Domain』は、10月31日にリリースされたレトロ風グラフィックの世界を探索する一人称視点のファンタジーアクションRPGだ。舞台となるのは広大な遺構が広がる「ニアシード島」。プレイヤーはとある国の王子となり、消息を絶った父王を探すことになる。しかし、訪れた島はいびつな怪物やアンデッドがはびこる迷宮と化しており、さらには古の女王までもが眠りから目覚めようとしているという。
このように方々で高い評価を得ている『Queen’s Domain』は11月23日、販売本数が30万本を突破したことを 発表 。発売から1か月足らずで達成したかたちとなる。なお、リリースから5日目の11月5日には10万本を報告しており、本作の好調ぶりがうかがえる。
開発を手がけるFreshly Baked Gamesはアメリカを拠点としており、Eric 氏とBradley 氏による2人体制と伝えられている小規模のインディースタジオだ。2人は2021年に同スタジオを設立。本作『Queen’s Domain』は2023年半ばに開発がスタートし、2026年9月のデモ版ではSteamユーザーレビューにて「非常に好評」ステータスを獲得した上、配信直前の10月30日には、Steamのウィッシュリスト登録数が 30万件を超えるなど 、販売前から大きな期待を集めていた。
『Queen’s Domain』は探索や戦闘において決して優しいと言える難易度のゲームではないかもしれないが、探索と発見を通じた未知の解明と報酬獲得の楽しみや、多様な手段が用意されている戦闘要素はそれを補って余りある魅力だ。このPS1風のレトロファンタジーRPG作品が今後どこまで評価を伸ばしていくのか注目していきたい。
『Queen’s Domain』はPC（ Steam ）/ PS5 / XBOX Series X|S / Nintendo Switch 2 向けに配信中だ。
『キングスフィールド』シリーズや『The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind』などから影響を受けた本作には、森や地下遺跡など複雑に入り組んださまざまなエリアが存在。隠し通路や扉などが各所に配置されており、永続的な強化アイテムや貴重な装備品などが眠っているものの、分かりやすいクエストマーカーや目印はなく、プレイヤーは自身のひらめきや試行錯誤を通して島を探索していくことになる。

iPhone Duoは、外側のディスプレイに加えて、筐体を開くことで内側に現れる横長の大きなディスプレイを備えているのが特徴。左右に開いた状態で机に立てたり、寝せた状態で片側のディスプレイだけを立てたりと、さまざまなスタイルでの利用が想定されている。チップには「A20 Pro」を搭載。さらに、Touch IDが復活しているほか、年内にApple Pencilにも対応予定だ。
一方で、折りたたみスマートフォンとしては開閉機構の耐久性が不安視されている。特にAppleはiPhone Duoで初めてこの分野に参入することもあり、競合製品と同様のメーカーのヒンジを使用しているとみられているものの、開閉機構が壊れる可能性があることを考えると、製品寿命が短いのではないかと指摘されてきた。
そこで海外メディアのCNETは、iPhone Duoを何回折りたたむことができるのか検証をすることにした。検証にあたっては、自動で折りたたみすることのできる機械を独自に制作し、約4秒に一回のペースで開いて閉じての動作を自動で繰り返させた。同製品が発売された10月23日頃から検証が始まり、10月27日からはYouTubeで連日ライブ配信をおこなっている。点検等の一時的な停止を除けば、基本的に24時間動作させ、土日を除く週5日に実施する約4時間のライブ配信を通して、その様子の一部を配信。CNETは端末が壊れるまでテストを続けるとしている。
そうして開閉を繰り返していたiPhone Duoだが、 15日目 の配信から異変が見られるように。開閉回数が45万回を突破したこの頃には、画面を180度完全に開くことはできず、指で押すとわずかに沈むといった具合に、緩んだ状態で止まっていることが確認されている。52万回を超えた 17日目 には閉じる方向についても、まれに閉じ切らずに半開きの状態になってしまうこともあった。
なおiPhone Duoの折りたたみディスプレイについては、一部の購入者からディスプレイに異常が発生したという報告が出ており、Apple側も不具合が生じた端末の交換に応じるという声明を発表している（ Reuters ）。また不具合ではなくディスプレイが故障した場合には高額な修理料金がかかり、たとえば内側ディスプレイの修理は、AppleCare+に加入していれば1万2900円でおこなえる一方で、保証対象外の場合18万2800円もかかる。多くの場合普段使いされるスマートフォンとしては、長期の使用にどれだけ耐えうるのかという部分も重要だろう。CNETがおこなっているような極端な検証が必ずしも参考になるとは限らないものの、これからも多くの人が結末を見守ることになりそうだ。

packages.headline: 「ニンテンドーゲームキューブ Nintendo Classics」のサイズが10GBの大台に。ソフト別インストール機能がそろそろ欲しくなりそう

sources.label: AUTOMATON
sources.evidenceText:
「ニンテンドー ゲームキューブ Nintendo Classics」の総容量が10GBを超え、「Nintendo Classics」シリーズの中では最も容量の大きなタイトルとなった。一方で、タイトル追加のたびに容量が大きく膨れ上がっていく本ソフト特有の課題が顕在化している。
「ニンテンドーゲームキューブ Nintendo Classics」のサイズが10GBの大台に。ソフト別インストール機能がそろそろ欲しくなりそう
任天堂は11月24日、『ウェーブレース ブルーストーム』を「ニンテンドー ゲームキューブ Nintendo Classics」に追加した（ 関連記事 ）。これに伴い、「ニンテンドー ゲームキューブ Nintendo Classics」の総容量が10GBを超え、「Nintendo Classics」シリーズの中では最も容量の大きなタイトルとなった。一方で、タイトル追加のたびに容量が大きく膨れ上がっていく本ソフト特有の課題が顕在化している。
「ニンテンドー ゲームキューブ Nintendo Classics」は2001年に任天堂から発売された「ニンテンドー ゲームキューブ」（以下、ゲームキューブ）で発売されたタイトルをNintendo Switch 2で楽しめるオムニバスソフトだ。
「Nintendo Classics」はNintendo Switch Onlineの加入者向けに提供されているクラシックゲームのサブスクリプションサービスで、ゲームキューブのほかにファミリーコンピュータ、スーパーファミコン、ゲームボーイ、NINTENDO 64、メガドライブ、ゲームボーイアドバンス、バーチャルボーイの専用ソフトが展開されている（メガドライブのみ「Nintendo Switch Online」表記）。
Nintendo Switch Online加入者であればファミリーコンピュータ、スーパーファミコン、ゲームボーイは追加料金なしでプレイ可能。ほかのハードは「Nintendo Switch Online + 追加パック」への加入が必須となる。また、ゲームキューブはNintendo Switch 2専用で、初代Nintendo Switchではプレイすることができない。それぞれの対応ハードでは、どこでもセーブや巻き戻しといった便利機能をはじめ、ローカル通信およびオンライン通信での2～4人プレイにも対応し、当時よりも遊びやすくなっているのが特徴だ。
そんな「ニンテンドー ゲームキューブ Nintendo Classics」の総容量が『ウェーブレース ブルーストーム』の追加に伴って10.9GBに増加した。『ウェーブレース ブルーストーム』配信前の段階でも、すでに9.5GBと大きめの容量となっていたが、ついにこのたび、1.4GBが足されて10GBの大台を超えてしまった格好である。
これほど容量が大きくなったのは、ゲームキューブがディスクメディアを採用したゲーム機であることが大きいだろう。ファミリーコンピュータ、スーパーファミコン、ゲームボーイ、ゲームボーイアドバンス、NINTENDO 64などの任天堂のコンソール機は、ROMカートリッジを主要なメディアとして採用していた。

packages.headline: Cyberpunk 2 Is Still a Ways Out, but CD Projekt Red Says Its RPGs Will Come Out Faster in the Future

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
We are still two years out from The Witcher 4, but Ciri's big breakout adventure isn't the only massive RPG cooking at CD Projekt Red. It sounds like development on Cyberpunk 2 is carrying on smoothly, though it's still very early in its development cycle.
Cyberpunk 2 Is Still a Ways Out, but CD Projekt Red Says Its RPGs Will Come Out Faster in the Future
We are still two years out from The Witcher 4 , but Ciri's big breakout adventure isn't the only massive RPG cooking at CD Projekt Red. It sounds like development on Cyberpunk 2 is carrying on smoothly, though it's still very early in its development cycle.
In a November 24 earnings call , CD Projekt Red VP of Strategy & Investor Relations Karolina Gnaś said the team is "making good progress with Cyberpunk 2, we are happy with where we are, but it's still too early to give a specific date and plan on when we will move onto full production." Although she couldn't provide a clear date when we'll hear more about the game, she did add that the studio plans to have around 200 developers by the end of 2026 and 320 by the end of next year.
It is admittedly a bit early to expect any kind of information about the Cyberpunk sequel, but it has been simmering in the background since at least 2022 , and it sounds like CD Projekt Red wants to speed up development of its massive RPGs. In its consolidated earnings report , CD Projekt Red admitted that most of its games "normally take 3 to 6 years to produce," mostly due to working on one game at a time. But that strategy has since changed.
In that same report, the company said, "At the moment, the CD Projekt Red studio is working in parallel on several productions (also in collaboration with external development teams) and supporting products, which is expected to translate into shorter intervals between the releases of subsequent titles in the future." Whether or not that new timeline will affect Cyberpunk 2 is the question.
But even if that faster development timeline is in effect for Cyberpunk 2, it's likely we'll still have to wait a while to actually see it in the wild. In an earnings report last year, when Cyberpunk 2 entered pre-production, CD Projekt CEO Michał Nowakowski suggested that CDPR's games take four or five years to move from pre-production to release, which would put the game somewhere in 2030 or 2031. And given that the game still hasn't entered full production, it isn't likely we're going to see some sort of rapid release after the Witcher 4 in 2028.
We're probably going to be waiting a little while longer for Cyberpunk 2, but it's already sounding like the game is taking shape. Just last month, associate game director Pawel Sasko revealed that a lot of the developers working on Cyberpunk 2 are former modders. Sasko went on to claim that "the modding community is really keeping [Cyberpunk 2077] alive," so hopefully that energy translates to Cyberpunk 2 – whenever it comes out.

GTA 6 Gets Officially Licensed Trading Cards Based on In-Game Collectibles
The hunt for GTA 6 trading cards is leaving the virtual confines of Leonida — Rockstar is teaming up with Panini America to bring the in-game collectibles to life.
The officially licensed GTA 6: Sports Trading Card Collection is based on Panini’s standard sports card system, featuring rare-numbered cards and team color parallels. The GTA collection adds Vice City-specific Silver, Pink, Teal, and Light Blue parallels to the standard slate of Legend Bronze, Silver, and Gold.
GTA 6 cards will be released in four-pack boxes, each of which, on average, come with two Rookies, one Retro, one Illustrated, and four Special Silvers. There’s no word on pricing, but hobby boxes currently listed on Panini’s site start at $30 and go up to over $700.
GTA 6 features a total of 480 trading cards across 16 individual sets, and we don't know exactly how many Panini is planning to turn into real cardboard. The sports-focused collectible company is less likely to adapt the collectible cards featuring other GTA 6 characters like Mandy and Vicki , but social media users can hope.
GTA 6 was officially the biggest entertainment launch of all time, and PlayStation just released a fresh batch of jaw-dropping player data . We considered the game a masterpiece in our 10/10 review , with Luke Reilly calling it "the single most impressive video game I have ever played."
Rockstar has gone all out on bringing the already very realistic Vice City to life , and a lot of the action has been happening in the world of sports. Rockstar took over Kaseya Center on the day of GTA 6's launch, with the Miami Heat donning Vice City jerseys for their game against the Milwaukee Bucks.

packages.headline: I Watched GTA 6's In-Game TV Shows for Hours, They're Absolutely Wild

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
Rockstar's satire has reached new levels with in-game cartoons like Barnyard Blue and the dark comedy The Tyrone Show.
I Watched GTA 6's In-Game TV Shows for Hours, They're Absolutely Wild
Of all the things I expected of Grand Theft Auto 6, sitting there watching in-game TV for like… two hours was not on my list. Freshly preloaded and ready to go on my Xbox Series X right at 3am on the west coast, claiming to be in New Zealand, booting it up for the first time had me rubbing my hands like Birdman – I was ready to get in the thick of it in GTA 6. What could this new Vice City's criminal underworld make me do? Not much. Will I have to survive shootouts early on, and will I need to contend with the new wanted system in a car chase? Not really. Mostly because as soon as I got to Jason's home in the opening hour, I sat my ass down on his living room couch, flipped on Weazel News and couldn't believe what I was seeing.
In GTA 6, you can sit on the couch and flip through three TV channels of original in-universe programming – full-on TV shows made for the game, existing within the fiction of its world. You have Weazel News, the nutty right-wing parody that broadcasts news segments and TV series with the production value of something we'd see in our real world. Then there's the Telemundo spoof called Megamundo that shows Spanish-language soap operas / telenovelas, but with the absurdity cranked up several notches. Lastly, there's the Visit Leonida channel that's dedicated to advertising tourist attractions and businesses across this fictional rendition of Florida, satirizing modern economics and business.
And no, these are not channels with maybe a couple minutes' worth of gags to see once and move on from – these act as legit television programming, shows with multiple episodes that go on for six to eight minutes each. Why would I flip through my free Roku channels or be hit with choice paralysis on my own TV's built-in streaming apps when GTA 6 could rapid fire some of the wildest shit the series has done with shows you'd never see on real TV?
I'd get a kick out of Alan Wake 2's Koskela Brothers commercials or Max Payne's Adventures of Captain Baseball Bat Boy episodes, which aligned with Remedy's style and universe. But it's kind of astonishing that GTA 6's level of production value for in-game entertainment would rival or exceed cable TV – if someone was going to do it, though, it'd be Rockstar.
The Visit Leonida channel features PSAs from the state government to warn them about wildlife outbreaks and the governor's pretty fucked-up crusade against furries. Those are interstitials between hysterical ad spots for the likes of car detailing shops, restaurants, and lawyers that spoof on American commercials for genuine laugh-out-loud moments. Tourism stingers poke at glorifying gentrification, overindulgence, and ads that play on selling working-class people on faux lavish lifestyles. Of course, GTA's advantage is not having to abide by FCC regulations, and that it's a video game after all – you can mock your audience all you want.
Where are you spending your extra time in GTA 6?
Vice City being based on Miami, GTA 6 is sprinkled with Cuban culture and brushes right up on the line of stereotypes. One commercial rapidly fires off all the services immigrants may need – "Need a notarized affidavit for your cousin's immigration papers? Boom. And we got pin pan puns, too! (Aye coño!) A new ID and a set of 26-inch rims? Hit up 'I Know A Guy'" If you're from this part of the world, these jokes do play into something very familiar to us (and referencing a pin pan pun tells me someone Cuban definitely wrote this commercial).
From satirical cartoons to edgy sitcoms, Rockstar's satire and parodies are unmatched.

packages.headline: Mass Effect Universe Would Have Answered Trilogy Ending Questions and Squadmate Fates, Writer Says

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
BioWare's canceled Mass Effect Universe would have addressed Mass Effect 3's controversial endings and the fates of Shepard's squadmates.
Mass Effect Universe Would Have Answered Trilogy Ending Questions and Squadmate Fates, Writer Says
BioWare's canceled Mass Effect Universe would have addressed Mass Effect 3's controversial endings and the fates of Shepard's squadmates, one of the game's writers has said.
For more than a decade, Mass Effect fans have debated how BioWare could reconcile the wildly divergent endings of Mass Effect 3 — and satisfy players who insisted that their particular ending choice should be canon (I see you, Destroy fans). But according to one of the writers behind the now-canceled Mass Effect Universe, the studio had actually cracked the puzzle before EA scrapped the project and closed BioWare forever.
Speaking during a reddit fan Q&A supporting the "Save Mass Effect" fan movement, Mass Effect: Annihilation novel author Cat Valente — who spent three years on the writing team for the unfinished sequel — offered a bittersweet glimpse into how the narrative team approached the franchise's biggest lingering questions.
While strict NDAs signed with published EA continue to prevent Valente from revealing specific plot details, she emphasized that reconciling Mass Effect 3's endings was front and center for the game's writers room, and noted that the team wasn't relying on a single silver bullet to bridge the 600-year narrative gap between the original trilogy and this upcoming fifth installment.
"[We] worked specifically, and for a very long and laborious time, on handling the endings in a way that wouldn't piss everyone off, at least not piss them off completely, that wouldn't make them feel like nothing mattered, wouldn't privilege any one kind of player over another, but also allow us, somehow, to actually write a coherent story going forward, within the limits of having to do it in a playable mainstream video game and not a post-modern 3000 page novel," Valente wrote.
"And it's become really clear that it's impossible to make the gaming community completely happy with anything no matter how hard you try, especially the ME endings that were so controversial, yet people feel so strongly about their own choices. We burned out so many valuable neurons going up against that problem. I know so many people think it's easy, just make Destroy canon and move on, but consider that, for example, I feel as strongly about Synthesis as others do about Destroy. And everyone feels strongly about choices mattering. Do you really think there is a single solution that would have satisfied everyone? In a *video game*?
As a hugely knowledgeable fan of the original trilogy — enough that she got the gig writing Andromeda's quarian ark prequel novel — Valente emphasized that the fates of the trilogy's loyal squadmates had also been a key consideration for the Mass Effect Universe team.
Plus Andromeda plot answers and more.
